name: io.github.mandalacomputer/mcp
title: Mandala Computer
description: Cloud desktops for AI agents: create a Linux computer, see its screen, click, type and run tasks.

environmentVariables.name: MANDALA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from Settings → Credentials → API keys. Optional after `mandala login`, which saves one.

environmentVariables.name: MANDALA_MODEL_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Anthropic or OpenAI key. Enables run_agent_chat, and makes run_agent and start_agent_run bill this key instead of the account's AI credits.

environmentVariables.name: MANDALA_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional saved profile from `mandala login --profile`; used when MANDALA_API_KEY is not set.

environmentVariables.name: MANDALA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional API base URL. Defaults to https://app.mandala.computer/api/v1.

environmentVariables.name: MANDALA_COMPUTER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional computer id to bind at startup, so use_computer is not needed.

environmentVariables.name: MANDALA_NO_LIFECYCLE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: 1, true, yes or on withholds the tools that create, clone or delete computers and snapshots.

environmentVariables.name: MANDALA_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: 1, true, yes or on keeps only read-only tools.

environmentVariables.name: MANDALA_TAGS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated tool tags to expose (for example computers,input); empty means every tool.
